about: The identities of Fauna's official apps and release artifacts, one entry per identity a user can compare against what they installed. fauna.social/apps takes its releases link from this file, and a merge-time check in the development tree refuses a merge whose entry disagrees with the tracked file the identity is pinned in (`source`), or whose tracked signing input this file does not list. Status `live` means the identity is in force today; `pending` means it is not issued or not published yet, and the `pending` sentence says why. A pending entry may still carry the value that will apply once it is tracked in the tree. Owner: docs/goal/architecture/release-integrity.md § Release signing → The official-apps list. A `source` under scripts/publish/public-files/ is published at the repository root (the release workflows live at .github/workflows/ in the public repository).

platforms.label: Web app
platforms.channel: Served by each nest at its own address under /app/ by default, and later also from the project's own address for the app, which serves the app's code and holds nothing of yours.

identities.label: The project's own address for the app
identities.pending: The project's own address for the app is not live yet. Until it is, the web app comes from a nest's own address, which each nest serves by default.
identities.how_to_check: Once live, the address bar reads exactly app.fauna.social. Any other address serving a Fauna app is a nest's own copy or someone else's.

identities.label: Published hash manifest of the served files
identities.pending: Every release will publish a list of the served files and their SHA-256 hashes, so anyone can rebuild the tagged source and compare. No release has published one yet.
identities.how_to_check: Rebuild the tagged source, hash the output, and compare it with the published list.

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.channel: A signed and notarized download from the project's releases page; the app tells you when a newer version is out.

identities.label: Bundle identifier
identities.how_to_check: Open the app bundle's Info.plist, or run `codesign -dv /Applications/Fauna.app`: the Identifier line reads social.fauna.fauna.

identities.label: Apple Developer Team ID
identities.how_to_check: Run `codesign -dv --verbose=2 /Applications/Fauna.app`: the TeamIdentifier line reads 7457N3M72H, and the Authority line names Developer ID Application: Fauna Social (7457N3M72H).

identities.label: Build attestation of the download
identities.pending: No signed macOS release has been published yet.
identities.how_to_check: Run `gh attestation verify Fauna-<version>.dmg --repo faunasocial/fauna`: it succeeds only for a download built by this repository's own release workflow.

identities.label: Mac App Store listing
identities.pending: There is no Mac App Store listing. The macOS app is distributed as a download from the project's releases page.
identities.how_to_check: A Mac App Store entry presenting itself as Fauna Social's app is not ours.

platforms.label: iOS
platforms.channel: The App Store, once the listing exists.

identities.label: Bundle identifier
identities.how_to_check: The same identifier as the macOS app: Apple keeps one record for both.

identities.label: Apple Developer Team ID
identities.how_to_check: On the App Store page, the seller reads Fauna Social; the Team ID is what Apple ties that name to.

identities.label: App Store listing
identities.pending: No App Store listing exists yet. The only way to run the iOS app today is to build it from the source yourself.
identities.how_to_check: Until the listing is announced here, an App Store entry presenting itself as Fauna Social's app is not ours.

platforms.label: Android
platforms.channel: Google Play, once the listing exists; a direct-download package and F-Droid may follow.

identities.label: Package name
identities.how_to_check: In the system settings' app details, or in the Play address bar (`id=social.fauna.fauna`), the package name is exactly this.

identities.label: Google Play listing
identities.pending: The app is in invitation-only internal testing on Google Play; its listing answers only to invited testers until the first public release.
identities.how_to_check: Until the listing is announced here, a Play entry presenting itself as Fauna Social's app is not ours.

identities.label: App signing certificate (SHA-256)
identities.pending: The first internal-testing release is out; this fingerprint is published once the certificate an installed copy actually carries has been read.
identities.how_to_check: Compare the installed app's signing certificate fingerprint (`apksigner verify --print-certs`, or a package-inspector app) with the value here.

platforms.label: Windows
platforms.channel: The Microsoft Store, once the submission is published; a direct-download installer for self-hosting.

identities.label: Store package name
identities.how_to_check: Run `Get-AppxPackage FaunaSocial.FaunaSocial` in PowerShell: the Name field is exactly this.

identities.label: Store package publisher
identities.how_to_check: The same `Get-AppxPackage` output's Publisher field is exactly this. The Store signs the package to it; nobody else can.

identities.label: Package family name
identities.how_to_check: The same output's PackageFamilyName field is exactly this.

identities.label: Publisher shown in the Store
identities.how_to_check: The Store listing's publisher line reads Fauna Social.

identities.label: Microsoft Store listing
identities.pending: The listing is reserved and nothing has been submitted yet. The address does not resolve until the first submission is published.
identities.how_to_check: Once live, the Store page for Fauna Social is at exactly this address; the Store ID in it is 9PLWNB0DJ0V7.

identities.label: Direct-download installer signature
identities.pending: The direct-download installer carries no Windows code signature until the SignPath Foundation's certificate for it is issued. Each release's installer is signed as a file with the release identity under Server and installers below, and Store installs are signed by the Store.
identities.how_to_check: Verify the installer file with cosign against the release identity below rather than by its Windows signature.

platforms.label: Linux
platforms.channel: The Linux app as a single program file, one for x64 and one for arm64, published with the pre-releases and releases; no desktop packages yet, and not on Flathub.

identities.label: Application ID
identities.how_to_check: The desktop entry, the Flatpak ID and the AppStream metainfo all carry exactly this ID.

identities.label: Published Linux app
identities.how_to_check: Each file is published with the pre-releases and releases under Server and installers below, signed with the same release identity; check it with the command given there. A desktop package (a .deb or a Flatpak) has not been released yet, and a Flathub entry presenting itself as Fauna Social's app is not ours.

platforms.label: Terminal app
platforms.channel: One archive per operating system and processor with each release (the terminal app, the sync agent and fauna-cli, the program an AI assistant runs to work in Fauna), signed with the same release identity as the server binaries; the macOS archives, once published, are also Developer ID-signed and notarized. The terminal app and fauna-cli are also included in the macOS package and the Windows installer.

identities.label: Published terminal-app archives
identities.how_to_check: The archives for Linux and Windows are published with the pre-releases and releases under Server and installers below, signed with the same release identity; check each one with the command given there. There are no macOS archives yet; on a Mac, build the terminal app, its sync agent and fauna-cli from the source.

platforms.label: Server and installers (GitHub releases)
platforms.channel: The server binaries, the Linux app, the terminal-app archives for Linux and Windows and the Windows installer are built by the repository's own release workflow, which signs each file it publishes with its release identity.

identities.label: Release repository
identities.how_to_check: Downloads come from this repository's Releases page and nowhere else, except the server's container image, which is this repository's package ghcr.io/faunasocial/nest.

identities.label: Release signing identity (Sigstore, keyless)
identities.how_to_check: There is no key fingerprint to list: the release workflow signs each file with a short-lived certificate naming this repository, which is what you verify against. Run `cosign verify-blob --certificate-identity-regexp='^https://github\.com/faunasocial/fauna/' --certificate-oidc-issuer='https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' --bundle <file>.bundle <file>`: it succeeds only for a file signed by this repository's own workflow.

identities.label: Server container image signature
identities.pending: The signature on the server image at ghcr.io/faunasocial/nest is not listed here yet; the Test channel's image is signed, the Dev channel's development builds are not, and there is nothing on the Stable channel until the first Stable release is out.
identities.how_to_check: The Test channel's image, and the Stable channel's once there is one, is verified with cosign against the release identity above; the Dev channel's development builds are not signed.
